title: PCG logs over 83,000 passengers at ports after Undas

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) recorded more than 83,000 passengers that have passed through ports nationwide on Tuesday, Nov. 3, after the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas. According to its latest tally, at least 44,720 outbound passengers and 38,738 inbound passengers were monitored between 6 a.m. and noon. The PCG said it deployed 6,145 frontline personnel and conducted inspections to 402 vessels and 688 motor bancas.
